credential_owner: CloudIdentity and the Cloud-owned local credential helper
credential_kind: session-bound agent credential, at most one hour and no longer than the parent session
transport_owner: Cloud helper calls the existing /api/v2/mcp endpoint using fixed MCP methods
authorization: Connect validates installed consumer, capability grant and connection revision on every invocation
CloudIdentity revalidates credential, audience, parent session, tenant, action and current membership
Workspace and other business owners retain object authorization
unknown_result: Record unknown_after_dispatch without automatic retry; read the original object or operation after access is restored
credential_projection: No bearer, cookie, password or credential file contents enter Framework registry, grants, invocation records, MCP input or UI
renewal: The signed-in user creates a new short-lived credential and imports it into the Cloud helper; this is not PAT, OAuth or refresh-token support
